item.title: Multiple variable scatterplot with two x axes
item.description: I'm trying to make a scatterplot with two x axes (comparing temperature and fluorescence to depth). Is there any way to do this? The problem I'm running into is that temperature and fluorescence need to be plotted on different x axes as they have different units and scales.
